thread:
ryan: Hey team — our per-model throughput graphs in the Console have been flatlined (zeros) since ~01:15 UTC last night. API is up but customers see high latency. Screenshot: https://img.redwood/mock/throughput-zero.png

alex: Sorry to hear that — can you paste the account id and which dashboard/panel? Do you still see tokens being consumed in billing? :thinking:

ryan: acct-9b2f. Billing shows token usage continuing; only the per-model sparkline and the 'throughput by model' panel are empty. Other metrics (total QPS) look normal.

alex: Thanks. Two quick checks: 1) can you run this from your side if possible? `curl -s https://metrics.redwood/acct-9b2f/metrics | grep redwood_model` — 2) did you notice any deploys/alerts around 01:00-02:00?

alertbot: deploy-bot: prometheus-exporter v1.4.0 rolled out to prod at 2026-03-15T01:06:22Z (commit d4e3f2a) :rocket:

maria: I'm looking at the exporter metrics. Prometheus scrape is healthy (`up{job="redwood-metrics-exporter"}` -> 1). However the metric keys changed in v1.4.0 — `redwood_model_throughput_total{model="..."}` used to be labeled `model`, now the exporter emits `redwood_model_throughput_total{model_id="...", model_rev="..."}`. Dashboards were built against `model` label so the grouping is returning empty.

alex: Ah that explains the per-model panels going silent (dashboard variables filter on `label_values(redwood_model_throughput_total, model)`). Is there a quick fix we can apply in the Console while the exporter patch rolls out?

maria: Yes — two short-term options: 1) update our Grafana queries to use `label_replace` to copy `model_id` -> `model`, e.g. `label_replace(redwood_model_throughput_total, "model", "$1", "model_id", "(.*)")` — or 2) add a compatibility shim in the exporter to emit the `model` label again. I've opened a PR for the shim (jen will link).

jen: PR: https://git.redwood/infra/prom-exporter/pulls/78 — adds backward-compat labels and tests. I can ship hotfix to the deploy group; request for change window: rolling patch will take ~5m with minimal disruption.

alex: For the customer's immediate troubleshooting steps: ryan, can you try the curl I suggested and paste one sample metric line? That helps us confirm mapping.

ryan: ran it, example line: `redwood_model_throughput_total{job="redwood-exporter",model_id="gpt-4o-instruct",model_rev="r12",account="acct-9b2f"} 12345` — confirms no `model` label.

maria: OK confirmed. I'll apply a quick dashboard override for the Console team: change panel queries to `label_replace(... )` until jen's PR is deployed. Alex, will you coordinate with Console Ops to push the query patch?

alex: On it — filing ops task and notifying Console team. Task: CONSOLE-4321 — add label_replace to model groupings and refresh templates. ETA 30m.

jen: Deploying exporter shim now to canary (canary group 3). Watching for metrics to reappear.

alertbot: deploy-bot: prom-exporter-canary rollout started at 2026-03-15T02:08:10Z (d4e3f2a -> d4e3f2a-hotfix)

maria: Canary metrics show both labels for emitted metrics now: `redwood_model_throughput_total{model_id="gpt-4o-instruct",model="gpt-4o-instruct",...}`. Grafana test panels show lines returning.

alex: Thanks all — ryan can you confirm your Console panels are back to normal once we finish the canary -> prod roll?

ryan: Saw the per-model panel repopulate at 02:12 UTC. Customers reported decreased latency (probably due to better routing). Really appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup:

alex: Marking as resolved for now. Follow-up actions: (1) prod rollout of exporter shim and then remove label_replace override, (2) add regression test in dashboards that verifies `label_values(redwood_model_throughput_total, model)` returns >0 series, (3) add release note for exporter label change. I'll update CONSOLE-4321 with status.

maria: I'll also add an alert to detect sudden drop-to-zero on per-model series so we catch this faster next time.

jen: PR merged and rolled out to prod at 2026-03-15T02:20:45Z.

ryan: Awesome, thanks everyone!
